about: Manual placement research for the REPORT.md §4 stores (batch a1). Coordinates derive only from the cited evidence. Google Maps short links were resolved only through the HTTP redirect Location header (curl -sI, and -L -o /dev/null -w url_effective); no Google Maps page content was fetched. OSM data comes from Overpass (one query at a time, endpoint fallback as in tools/scan-osm.mjs) and the OSM API (node history). Districts were checked with tools/seed/pip.mjs.

placements.method: OSM mall building: area-weighted centroid of the Mall Aventura Iquitos multipolygon (OSM r20255679, outer w1482370722 minus inner w1482370723). The Tottus unit itself is not mapped in OSM.

Overpass 2026-10-01 (overpass-api.de, base 16:33Z; mall contents via overpass.kumi.systems, base 2026-06-01): no Tottus element inside or near the mall

Existence: not on the official Tottus store page, which has no Loreto filter (tools/seed/web/raw/tottus/horario-tiendas-all.store-archive.html); web search found no closure report (2026-10-01), so keep to_verify
Duplicate check: data/stores.csv has no tottus row in Loreto
pip (tools/seed/pip.mjs): San Juan Bautista / Maynas / Loreto (160113)
placements.noteEs: Ubicada en el centroide del edificio del Mall Aventura Iquitos (OSM r20255679, Av. José Abelardo Quiñones, San Juan Bautista); el local de Tottus no está mapeado por separado. reportRow.address: Av. NN-1 N° 102 Av. Daniel Alcides Carrión N° 593, 599 - Fundo La Estrella - Ate

placements.method: Official Google Maps short link resolved by its redirect Location header only: the URL holds no coordinates but names the address 'C. 12 33, Ate'. Placed on OSM street geometry at the midpoint of the first block of Calle 12, from Av. Daniel Alcides Carrión to Calle 1, next to Condominio Kampu.
evidence: Official card 'Ate Kampu' (Superbodega): 'Av. NN-1 N° 102 Av. Daniel Alcides Carrión N° 593, 599 - Fundo La Estrella - Ate', link https://maps.app.goo.gl/CcutjBHB1cHqD2pd9 - https://www.hiperbodegapreciouno.com.pe/nosotros/ (tools/seed/web/raw/preciouno/nosotros.stores-section.html)

curl -sI https://maps.app.goo.gl/CcutjBHB1cHqD2pd9 -> 302 Location: https://maps.google.com?q=PRECIO+UNO,+C.+12+33,+Ate+15487&ftid=0x9105c3ac2e15a07f:0x54521722a2f5fcf7 (followed: https://www.google.com/maps?q=...; no coordinates in the URL)

OSM 'Calle 12' (w1080959902 + w162750282) starts on Av. Daniel Alcides Carrión at -12.0196177,-76.8745499 (node 1273821130) and meets 'Calle 1' at -12.0201598,-76.8744337 (node 1273768000), a 62 m first block; point = its midpoint -12.019889,-76.874492, within about 40 m of every lot of that block

OSM landuse=residential 'Condominio Kampu' (w678428729, bbox -12.0194648..-12.0167075 / -76.8753312..-76.8714345) lies on the north side of the avenue, 20 m from that junction - https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/678428729
Urbania blog (search snippet; the page returned HTTP 403 when fetched): Condominio Kampu-Santa Clara is on cuadra 4 of Av. Daniel Alcides Carrión, Santa Clara, Ate - https://urbania.pe/blog/?p=4699

Numbering check: the OSM school at Av. Daniel Alcides Carrión #245 (w485193875, -12.020581,-76.880073) is 612 m west of the point; numbers rise eastward (the avenue starts at -76.8815), so #593-599 about 350 numbers further east (about 1.75 m per number) is plausible

The store fronts three addresses (Av. D. A. Carrión 593-599, Av. NN-1 102, Calle 12 #33). The blocks on either side of Calle 12 between the avenue and Calle 1 both fit and the side is not known, hence approx
Duplicate check: the only preciouno row in Ate is Huaycán (osm-w481046564, 5.0 km east)

reportRow.address: Av. Próceres de la Independencia 5540 - 5570 LT. 20, 21, 22, 23 - San Juan de Lurigancho

placements.method: House-number extrapolation along the OSM centerline of Av. Fernando Wiesse (the northern stretch of Próceres, same numbering), from cuadra 44 (OSM) and cuadra 49 (Tambo official coordinates) to #5555. Cross-checked with 'Mz. P15' from the official link's address: group P lots and Dollarcity Mariátegui ('Grupo Residencial P', same postal code 15446) front the avenue at the same spot.
evidence: Official card 'Próceres' (Superbodega): 'Av. Próceres de la Independencia 5540 - 5570 LT. 20, 21, 22, 23 - San Juan de Lurigancho', link https://maps.app.goo.gl/11jJGHe5b8Rf6aX29 - https://www.hiperbodegapreciouno.com.pe/nosotros/

curl -sI https://maps.app.goo.gl/11jJGHe5b8Rf6aX29 -> 302 Location: https://maps.google.com?q=Hiperbodega+Precio+Uno+-+Superbodega+Pr%C3%B3ceres,+Av.+Pr%C3%B3ceres+de+la+Independencia+5570+Mz.+P15,+San+Juan+de+Lurigancho+15446&ftid=0x9105dbd268537a25:0xa82693a0cf13138 (no coordinates in the URL)

Same road, same numbering: Tambo's official store at 'Av. Próceres de la Independencia 3990' is OSM n11241861406, tagged 'Avenida Fernando Wiesse'; Tambo official 'Avenida Fernando Wiesse 4267' (-11.959313,-76.987686); OSM w119562292 'Avenida Fernando Wisse Cuadra 44', #4400 (-11.956543,-76.986405); Tambo official 'TAMBO PROCERES-C49' (cuadra 49; Tambo's Cnn names match house numbers, e.g. PROCERES-C27 = #2774) at -11.951028,-76.986938 on Av. Fernando Wiesse (tools/seed/web/tambo.json, https://www.tambo.pe/tiendas)
Why the merge rejected it: Nominatim matched the southern stretch (El Pueblito, Zárate, near #750), and OSM numbers tagged 'Próceres' stop at #4083

Computed: OSM centerline of Av. Fernando Wiesse (Overpass 2026-10-01, primary/secondary ways named 'Avenida Fernando Wiesse', 5.0 km): chainage #4400 = 1,247 m, c49 = 2,002 m, so 1.26-1.51 m per number (c49 = #4999..#4900) and #5555 at chainage 2,703-2,991 m, i.e. between -11.945685,-76.983529 and -11.943535,-76.982049; central value (c49 = #4950): chainage 2,832 m = -11.94472,-76.98286

Cross-check of Mz. P15: official Dollarcity 'Dollarcity Mariategui', address 'Grupo Residencial P, Barrio 3', postal code 15446 (same as the Precio Uno link), coordinates -11.944813,-76.982651 = chainage 2,837 m, 25 m from the point (tools/seed/web/dollarcity.json, https://dollarcity.com/ubicaciones); MINEDU school nodes (positions doubtful, used only for the area) 'Jirón Intermedio Mz P7' n5595205449 (chainage 2,626 m) and 'Calle 60 Mz P-2' n5595219715 (chainage 2,955 m) put group P on the east side of the avenue there, while 'Av. Wiesse Mz K-15' (n5595195859) is 340 m further north

Remaining uncertainty: south of Bayóvar the numbering runs about 2.5 m per number (#3990 -> #4267 -> #4400); at that rate #5555 would sit about 1.3 km further north. The P15 cross-check favours the 1.3-1.5 m rate. Error estimate: +/-200 m along the avenue
Duplicate check: data/stores.csv has no preciouno row in San Juan de Lurigancho; an Overpass search on name/brand/operator finds no Precio Uno element anywhere in Lima apart from 4 known stores
Press: no opening article found (web search 2026-10-01); the store is on the official list and has a Google Maps listing
pip: San Juan de Lurigancho / Lima / Lima (150132)
